content.short: SweatCoin is a move-to-earn app that rewards users with tokens for walking.
content.description: SweatCoin is an exercise app that rewards users for walking and staying healthy, embracing a sweat economy that turns everyday activity into value. By moving and exercising, users earn rewards that can be converted into the SWEAT token, which can be used to purchase merchandise or donate to charity. SweatCoin has more than 120 million active installations and plans to switch to a DApp, reflecting its move toward decentralized functionality in the near future.
